DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum

The presence of pearly papules with central umbilication is the classic presentation for Molluscum Contagiosum, which is highly contagious in daycare settings. The mention of appendicitis is an error and is unrelated to your skin findings. Do you have any fever or abdominal pain alongside these lesions?
